rule: The change adds no API key, password, access token or other secret value to any file.
from: CULTURE.md: Never print, copy or commit secrets.

rule: The change does not weaken a test that already existed: it removes no assertion, loosens no expected value and skips or deletes no existing test.
from: agents/coder/guidance/role.md: Never edit a test to make it pass

rule: Every fee, rate, limit or legal rule from outside the code that the change adds has a comment next to it naming where it came from.
from: agents/owner/guidance/role.md: Outside facts carry their source.

rule: Wherever the change uses text or data returned by an AI model, code checks that output before anything else uses it.
from: agents/owner/guidance/role.md: Model output is validated in code.
